ritual: Read this file first, then A2A.md and docs/HARDWARE.md.
Work, run the gates, commit with measurements, update this file in-file.
rules: The firmware is scripture: if it looks wrong, our reading is wrong.
Measure before patching; the compiler and the run are the judges.
Read PDFs as rendered pages with vision; OCR text is only an index.
Model the silicon, not the firmware's minimum. An unmapped register is a recorded gap.
Use absolute Windows paths with the drive colon for file tools.
Do not copy code from Prehistoricman/TMS57070: it has no licence.
Decoded firmware stays in rom/, outside git; regenerate it with the decoder.
